steps.title: Analyze Hello App Audio Requirements
steps.description: Inspect Hello App structure and design a native synthesizer engine avoiding external file assets.

steps.title: Establish Pure Native Sound Synth Engine
steps.description: Create SoundEngine.java with core PCM wave generation logic using the built-in Android AudioTrack API.

steps.title: Design Interactive Click Feedback Waveform
steps.description: Synthesize a rapid exponential decay sine sweep in SoundEngine.java to represent subtle tactile clicks.

steps.title: Design Atmospheric Energetic Synth Signature
steps.description: Build a fast-cycling 8-bit digital square wave arpeggio cascade matching the high-intensity energetic mood.

steps.title: Design Atmospheric Calm Acoustic Bell Signature
steps.description: Draft a multi-tonal slow-decay dual frequency sine wave bell chime reflecting complete serenity.

steps.title: Design Atmospheric Inspiring Celestial Shimmer Signature
steps.description: Engineer a cosmic pitch-modulating ascending celestial sweep layered with dynamic frequency vibration.

steps.title: Design Volumetric Sci-Fi Calculation Synthesis
steps.description: Create a multi-frequency chord generator inside SoundEngine.java that shifts tonal intervals depending on current vibe selection.

steps.title: Integrate Sound Toggle Trigger in Main Layout
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml to introduce a horizontal layout grouping the welcome message and a 3D Neobrutalist sound switch.

steps.title: Initialize Sound Control Button in Main Activity
steps.description: Hook btnSoundToggle inside MainActivity.java and coordinate state retention with the active SoundEngine parameters.

steps.title: Wire Up Energetic, Calm, Inspiring Atmospheric Audio Triggers
steps.description: Inject responsive synthesizers within each Vibe-Chip listener callback to trigger mood shifts immediately on touch.

steps.title: Wire Up Calculation Engine Power-Up Sound Effects
steps.description: Trigger vibe-specific sci-fi acoustic calculation chords when clicking the volumetric action button.

steps.title: Wire Up Cyber-Click Wisdom Refresh Sounds
steps.description: Integrate quick snap-decay digital click feedbacks when user iterates quotes inside the wisdom drawer.

steps.title: Add Audio Feedback on Interactive Cube Touch
steps.description: Update Cube3DView.java to play interactive audio ticks upon physical viewport touch events.

steps.title: Sanity Check Android Namespaces and File Structures
steps.description: Check XML compliance and compile assets under complete Java 8 compatibility.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Compile, build and assemble Hello App using Gradle commands.
